about_the_game:
🐟 Full Tank Upgrade – For Desktank

Love your aquarium but wish it could hold even more fish?
This upgrade increases your tank capacity from 25 to 100 fish, letting you build the ultimate relaxing desktop aquarium.

✨ What’s included:

  • 🐠 Raise your fish limit from 25 to 100

  • 🌊 Enjoy all current and future fish species

  • 🔄 Fully compatible with all upcoming updates

  • ❤️ A gentle way to support Desktank's development

Nothing else changes — you keep the full experience, just with a much bigger tank. Thanks for supporting cozy indie devs!
